sentences.text: Blizzard Entertainment , Inc. is an American video game developer and publisher based in Irvine , California , and is a subsidiary of the American company Activision Blizzard .	Activision Blizzard	Activision Blizzard	video game developer	video game developer	publisher	video game publisher	Activision	Activision

The company was founded on February 8 , 1991 , under the name Silicon & Synapse by three graduates of the University of California , Los Angeles : Michael Morhaime , Frank Pearce , and Allen Adham .	Michael Morhaime	Michael Morhaime	Frank Pearce	Frank Pearce (businessman)	Allen Adham	Allen Adham

The company originally concentrated primarily on the creation of game ports for other studios before beginning development of their own software in 1993 with the development of games like Rock n ' Roll Racing and The Lost Vikings .	The Lost Vikings	The Lost Vikings	ports	Porting
In 1994 the company became Chaos Studios , then Blizzard Entertainment , Inc. after being acquired by distributor Davidson & Associates .	Davidson & Associates	Davidson & Associates
Shortly thereafter , Blizzard released Warcraft : Orcs & Humans .	Warcraft	Warcraft

Blizzard went on to create several other video games , including Warcraft sequels , the Diablo series , the StarCraft series , and in 2004 the massively multiplayer online role-playing game World of Warcraft .	Diablo	Diablo (series)	StarCraft	StarCraft	Warcraft	Warcraft	massively multiplayer online role-playing game	massively multiplayer online role-playing game	World of Warcraft	World of Warcraft	multiplayer	multiplayer

Their most recent projects include the first expansion for Diablo III , Reaper of Souls , the online collectible card game Hearthstone : Heroes of Warcraft , the sixth expansion for World of Warcraft , Legion , the multiplayer online battle arena Heroes of the Storm , the third and final expansion for StarCraft II : Wings of Liberty , Legacy of the Void , and the multiplayer first-person shooter Overwatch . On July 9 , 2008 , Activision merged with Vivendi Games , culminating in the inclusion of the Blizzard brand name in the title of the resulting holding company .	Activision	Activision	Vivendi Games	Vivendi Games
On July 25 , 2013 , Activision Blizzard announced the purchase of 429 million shares from majority owner Vivendi .	Activision Blizzard	Activision Blizzard	Activision	Activision
As a result , Activision Blizzard became a completely independent company .	Activision Blizzard	Activision Blizzard	Activision	Activision

Blizzard Entertainment hosts conventions for fans to meet and to promote their games : the BlizzCon in California , United States , and the Blizzard Worldwide Invitational in other countries , including France and South Korea .
